plan.title: RFQ Auto Title for Two Locations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ without entering a title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add two rows for the specified product.
Set the first product row's delivery location.
Confirm the first row contains the requested product.
Confirm the product's automatically selected variant.
Confirm the first location was applied.
Set the second product row's delivery location.
Confirm the second row contains the requested product.
Confirm the second row's automatically selected variant.
Confirm the second location was applied.
